accepted_claims.locator: Original Plus launch, benefits and free access
accepted_claims.rationale: The dated 1 February 2023 original-launch post lists peak-time access, faster responses and priority, as offered benefits. The living page records a later expansion separately; no 2022 or present-day terms are inferred.
The guide describes identity numbers, logout accounting and file restrictions; a private code is described prospectively. The publication date does not date first use.

The exact release agreement states the limited grant and the specified distribution and model-improvement terms; this is a description of that document, not a conclusion about later terms or legal effect.
The authors give 1.2 TB before their GPT-3 VRAM reduction; attributed claim, not a universal minimum.
The same authors give 350 GB after the reduction, with pretrained weights retained. Section 5 describes V100 experiments; the cited passage does not specify a dtype for this figure.
The authors state 33B Guanaco can be trained on 24 GB consumer GPUs in under 12 hours; this is capability wording, not proof of a completed run or a specific GPU count.
The 24 GB is per consumer GPU; the number of GPUs is not stated in this passage. Paper context concerns 4-bit QLoRA and fine-tuning, not pretraining.

The author describes the DARPA-sponsored university service as an intermediary and SOAR process constraints. The publication event is bounded to the account and does not assert price or order completion.
